heroSubheading: Everything you need to keep your property running.
aboutHtml:
We're your local STIHL dealer here in Paraparaumu. We stock the full range of STIHL equipment you need for your garden, farm, or property. Chainsaws, trimmers, blowers, hedge cutters—whatever the job, we have the gear. Whether you're looking after a small garden or managing larger acreage, you'll find what you're after here.

Our workshop services and repairs your STIHL equipment, keeping your gear running well and lasting longer. We stock spare parts and can help with maintenance and troubleshooting. Come in and talk to us about what you need. We'll help you choose the right tool for your job and get you sorted. We're here when you need advice or support with your equipment.

Stop by and see us. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, and weekends 9am to 3pm.
